summary: The only news that hit the book today was macro. October CPI came in hot (+0.4% headline, +0.3% core, both above forecast) and markets now price about a 99% chance of a hike at the Dec. 9 Fed meeting, up from about 82% before the print. Equity was down $1.08 on the day and IEF (-0.83%) and BND (-0.71%) were the weakest holdings. No holding has an 8-K in the last 7 days, and no stock-specific headline hurts a thesis. The company news on holdings was positive: WMT price-target raises (UBS $149, JPM $145, BMO $136), CARG target raises to $41 (Barclays, Citi), and a routine KR store opening. No stop or invalidation clause was hit at the close (marks from market_value/qty: DPZ ~330, IDXX ~697, VNQ ~97.1, BND ~71.1, IEF ~91.0, CARG ~34.6, VRSN ~312, KR ~68.6, MSCI ~657, FAST ~54.3, MSM ~119.3, WMT ~125.7).
upcoming: Watch first: the bond sleeve. BND closed at about $71.1, 1.6% above its $70.0 stop, and IEF at about $91.0, 1.7% above its $89.5 stop. IEF's clause 'a hawkish Fed outcome pushes yields materially higher' is now in play before the meeting: the hot CPI and 99% December hike odds are the setup, but the Fed outcome itself does not come until Dec. 9, so the clause is not met yet. Another hot data print this week could trip both price stops. WMT: estimated earnings ~2026-11-19, about 7 trading days out. That is an estimate (last year's date + 364 days), so confirm the date. The thesis has a guidance-cut clause, and the stock has run to ~$125.7 on a wave of target raises, so the print is a two-way event. KR reports ~12-03 (estimated); there is no news on the 10-17 grocery cyber incident. VNQ is rate-sensitive, but its TLT clause (TLT more than 3% below its 200-day) was about 1% below as of this morning's check and needs re-checking after the CPI move. VOO/VTI: S&P futures slipped after CPI. The SPY 200-day line (~728) is the stop for both and should be re-checked tomorrow. Crypto: BTC fell below $75k on 11-09 with about $1.2B of liquidations and ETF outflows. There is no exchange failure and no new regulation (the Binance-hack laundering story is a follow-up to an older hack). The agent holds no crypto. Non-held names: TTEK reports ~11-11 (a shadow holding), SBH reported today with soft Q1 guidance, and ADSK and BBY are estimated for ~11-24.
